accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
accessibility.intro: We believe everyone should be able to enjoy our venue and our website comfortably and independently. Here is what we have done, and how to reach us.

sections.title: Our commitment to accessibility
body: Baloona is committed to serving all of our guests equally and to improving the service we give guests with disabilities. We invest significant effort and resources in making both the website and the venue accessible, in the belief that everyone deserves equality, dignity, comfort and independence.

sections.title: Website accessibility
body: This website was made accessible in line with the Israeli Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities Regulations (Service Accessibility Adjustments), 2013, and the Israeli standard (IS 5568) based on WCAG 2.1 level AA.
The site is built for the common browsers and for mobile use, and supports keyboard navigation and screen readers.

sections.title: Accessibility features on the site
list: Valid semantic structure that assistive technologies can navigate.
Sufficient color contrast between text and background.
Full keyboard navigation with a clear focus indicator.
Responsive layout for narrow screens and mobile devices.

sections.title: Accessibility at the venue
list: A friendly team happy to help with anything you need.

sections.title: Exclusions and limitations
body: We make every effort to keep the site accessible and to update it regularly. Even so, some sections or content may not yet be fully accessible. We continue to improve accessibility as part of our commitment to making the site usable by everyone.

accessibility.contactBody: Ran into a problem, or have a suggestion for improving accessibility? We would love to hear from you and will handle every request promptly. Contact our accessibility coordinator:

terms.title: Terms & Conditions and Cancellation Policy
terms.intro: The terms of use and cancellation policy below apply to purchasing digital punch cards and using the Baloona site and services. Please read them carefully before making a purchase.

sections.title: General
body: The site is operated by Baloona (the "Company", "we"). These terms are written in one grammatical form for convenience only and are addressed to all genders.
Making a purchase or using the site constitutes full acceptance of these terms. If you do not agree to them, please do not use the site.
The Company may update these terms from time to time; the binding version is the one published on the site at the time of purchase.

sections.title: The punch cards and service
body: A digital punch card grants a fixed number of entries to the venue, as stated on the purchased product.
A punch card is personal and may not be transferred or exchanged for money unless stated otherwise.
An entry is punched on arrival at the venue; the remaining balance updates in real time and can be viewed via the card's personal link.
Use of the venue and its facilities is subject to the venue rules and the staff's instructions.

sections.title: Prices and payments
body: Prices on the site are in New Israeli Shekels and include VAT as required by law.
Payment is made through a secure payment gateway; an order confirmation is sent once payment is received.
The Company may update prices from time to time; the binding price is the one shown at the time of purchase.

sections.title: Cancellation and refunds
body: Cancellation is handled in accordance with the Israeli Consumer Protection Law, 1981, and the Consumer Protection (Cancellation of a Transaction) Regulations, 2010.
A punch-card purchase may be cancelled within 14 days of purchase, provided it has not been used (no entry has been punched).
For a cancellation not due to a defect or mismatch, the Company will refund the payment less a cancellation fee of 5% of the transaction price or 100 ₪, whichever is lower.
For a partially used card, a proportional credit for the unused entries may be given, at the Company's discretion and subject to law.
A cancellation request should be sent to customer service using the details on the site, together with the purchase details; the refund is issued to the original payment method.

sections.title: Card validity
body: A punch card is valid for the period stated at the time of purchase, or for a reasonable period as determined by the Company.
Entries not used by the end of the card's validity period may expire, subject to law.

sections.title: Liability
body: The Company makes efforts to keep the site and service available and functioning, but does not guarantee uninterrupted, fault-free operation.
Use of the venue and its facilities is at the user's responsibility and in accordance with the safety and staff instructions.

sections.title: Privacy
body: The details provided at purchase are used to provide the service, manage the card and make contact, and will not be shared with a third party except to complete the transaction or as required by law.

sections.title: Contact
body: For questions, enquiries and cancellation requests, contact Baloona customer service using the details on the site.
